cover: Iranian strikes hit Gulf targets as historic rocket catch stuns aerospace world
cover_scene: A mechanical launch tower catching a massive spacecraft at dawn while naval warships patrol stormy desert waters under flare light.

slides.scene: Air defense interceptors blazing through the night sky over a Gulf coastline, protecting military radar domes and airbase runways from incoming cruise missiles.
slides.headline: Iran Targets US Military Base in Bahrain
slides.body: Iran launched cruise missiles and drones targeting American military airbases and radar installations in Bahrain. Bahraini air defenses intercepted several incoming aerial weapons with no major casualties reported, escalating regional tensions across the Persian Gulf corridor.

slides.scene: A towering steel launch gantry with giant mechanical arms cradling a massive descending rocket stage against a coastal Texas sky.
slides.headline: SpaceX Catches Returning Rocket with Tower Arms
slides.body: SpaceX successfully caught the upper stage of its Starship rocket using mechanical chopstick arms on the Texas launch tower. The milestone demonstrates heavy-lift spacecraft recovery, marking a breakthrough toward rapid and complete orbital vehicle reusability.

slides.scene: A fortified border fence topped with razor wire stretching along a desolate forest line beneath heavy grey Baltic skies.
slides.headline: Estonia Shuts Russian Border Crossings After Sabotage
slides.body: Estonian authorities announced the closure of border crossings with Russia after an attempted sabotage incident targeted a drone manufacturing facility. The move follows heightened security alerts across the Baltic region regarding foreign covert intelligence operations.

slides.scene: Voters gathered near transparent ballot boxes in a brightly lit polling hall, surrounded by green and white Nigerian national bunting.
slides.headline: AI Disinformation Concerns Cloud Upcoming Nigerian Election
slides.body: Nigeria is confronting mounting alarms over artificial intelligence manipulation after suspected synthetic images surfaced in preliminary voter registers. The electoral commission faces heightened scrutiny as President Bola Tinubu prepares for a contested 2027 reelection campaign.
